topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a folded piece of paper tucked away in a drawer, the edges slightly worn, as if it had been unfolded and folded back many times. It was my partner’s bucket list. The handwriting was familiar, each item a whispered promise of a future we could share. Travel to Greece, learn to dance salsa, start a garden. My heart swelled as I read, imagining the smiles and laughter these adventures would bring. I felt a gentle urge to make each dream a reality, to walk this path together, step by joyful step.
